author: Cleo Abram
description:
This tiny transformer robot was built for the moon… 

It’s about the size of a baseball, BUT INSIDE…are cameras, two wheels, and a tail. It’s great for fitting in small spacecraft and exploring places larger rovers can’t go. 

Two of them launched on a Japanese rocket back in 2024 and sent back THESE photos of the lunar surface….

To see what happens next, subscribe!

DOI: 10.1126/scirobotics.aec8039

#moon #rover #transformer #space #explore #robot
title: This Transformer Robot Went To The Moon
